Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message type is used to signal a market or data feed handler event.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Refer to System Event Codes below

Field.Name: Current Year
Field.Description: The current calendar year (example: 2016).

Field.Name: Current Month
Field.Description: The current calendar month, with values 1 to 12 inclusive, January=1, etc.

Field.Name: Current Day
Field.Description: The current calendar day, with values 1 to 31 inclusive.

Field.Name: Version
Field.Description: Version of this interface. Currently set to 1.

Field.Name: Sub-version
Field.Description: Sub-version of this interface. Currently set to 0.

Message.Name: Complex Strategy Directory Message
Message.Description: Whenever a complex order is added in the system for an underlying, the order is normalized and results in either the creation of a new complex strategy or is added to an existing strategy. A Complex Strategy Message containing the strategy definition will be sent.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: ISE’s Strategy ID assigned daily, valid while there are any open complex orders for the day

Field.Name: StrategyType
Field.Description: StrategyType value

Field.Name: Source
Field.Description: Identifies the source of the Strategy, valid for the trading day

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying Symbol for the strategy. All legs in this strategy belong to this Underlying

Field.Name: Number Of Legs
Field.Description: Number of legs in the strategy NOTE: Leg field offsets below are an equation, where “n” is the zero based leg number (0, 1, …)

Message.Name: Strategy Trading Action Message
Message.Description: ISE uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of a strategy within the ISE Options Market.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: ISE’s Strategy ID assigned daily, valid while there are any open complex orders for the day

Field.Name: Current Trading State
Field.Description: Reflects the current trading state for the strategy on the ISE market.

Message.Name: Strategy Open Closed Message
Message.Description: The options system uses this administrative message to indicate when an strategy has completed the opening process and is now available for auto execution or when the option has closed and is no longer available for auto execution.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the option, as defined in the Options Directory Message.

Field.Name: Open State
Field.Description: Reflects the current eligibility for auto execution of the options security in the options market.

Message.Name: Complex Strategy Order on Book Message
Message.Description: An Order on Book message is generated for all the following situations whenever an order free from any display restrictions is reported by the matching engine. In all such cases the order size to be displayed is as reported by the matching engine

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the strategy, as defined in the Strategy Directory Message.

Field.Name: Order Type
Field.Description: Order Type

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: ‘B’ = Bid ‘A’ = Offer (Ask) ‘ ’ (blank) = not set (hidden)

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price of the order in fixed point format with 6 whole number places followed by 4 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Size of the order

Field.Name: Exec Flag
Field.Description: ‘N’ = None ‘A’ = AON

Field.Name: Order Capacity
Field.Description: Order Capacity value

Field.Name: Scope
Field.Description: Scope value

Field.Name: Owner ID
Field.Description: Spaces when not set

Field.Name: Giveup
Field.Description: Spaces when not set

Field.Name: CMTA
Field.Description: Spaces when not set

Message.Name: Complex Strategy Auction Message
Message.Description: This message is used to announce strategy auctions. The start of auction is announced, followed by possible updates on the auction, and announcing the end of the auction.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the option, as defined in the Options Directory Message.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Integer which uniquely identifies the auction.

Field.Name: Order Type
Field.Description: ‘M’ = Market ‘L’ = Limit

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: ‘B’ = Bid ‘A’ = Offer (ask) ‘ ’ (blank) = not set (hidden)

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price in fixed point format with 6 whole number places followed by 4 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Size

Field.Name: Exec Flag
Field.Description: ‘N’ = None ‘A’ = AON

Field.Name: Order Capacity
Field.Description: Order capacity value

Field.Name: Scope
Field.Description: ‘L’ = Local ‘N’ = National

Field.Name: Owner ID
Field.Description: Spaces when not set

Field.Name: Giveup
Field.Description: Spaces when not set

Field.Name: CMTA
Field.Description: Spaces when not set

Field.Name: Auction Event
Field.Description: ‘S’ = Start ‘U’ = Auction Update ‘E’ = End of Auction

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: ‘E’ = Exposure ‘C’ = Facilitation ‘S’ = Solicitation ‘P’ = PIM

Field.Name: Number of Responses
Field.Description: Number of auction Responses. Next two fields repeat that number of times. Allowable values for this field are 0 or 1.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: ISE’s Option ID for this leg, valid for the trading day. The same ID as the corresponding Option in the Options Directory Message. Zero (0) for Stock Leg.

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the option root symbol (security symbol)

Field.Name: Leg ID
Field.Description: Leg identifier within this strategy. This is an exchange-assigned 0-based index. E.g. Nth leg has LegId=N-1.

Field.Name: Expiration Year
Field.Description: Last two digits of the year of the option expiration

Field.Name: Expiration Month
Field.Description: Expiration Month of the option (1-12)

Field.Name: Expiration Day
Field.Description: Day of the Month of expiration (1-31)

Field.Name: Explicit Strike Price
Field.Description: Denotes the explicit strike price of the option. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Field.Name: Option Type
Field.Description: Option Type:

Field.Name: Leg Side
Field.Description: Indicates the side of the leg

Field.Name: Leg Ratio
Field.Description: Leg Ratio

Field.Name: Response Price
Field.Description: Price of the auction response in fixed point format with 6 whole number places followed by 4 decimal digits. The response, if shown (zero if not shown) is the best response on the contra side.

Field.Name: Response Size
Field.Description: Size of the auction response (zero if not shown).

Value.Description: Start of Normal Hours Closing Process

Value.Name: Start of Late Hours Closing Process
Value.Description: Start of Late Hours Closing Process
